extension.name: AgentPay Pre-Pay Audit — Grade an endpoint before your agent pays it
extension.description: Audit a paid API before money moves: grade the endpoint's 402 terms, see what the live market actually charges, and confirm the wallet can complete the payment right now.
extension.author: AgentPay Team

commands.name: speckit.prepay-audit.check
commands.description: Grade a paid endpoint's 402 terms before the agent pays it — score, defects, real settlement cost

commands.name: speckit.prepay-audit.ready
commands.description: Confirm the wallet can actually complete this payment right now — signable terms, live facilitator, gas priced, balance vs shortfall

commands.name: speckit.prepay-audit.market
commands.description: See where an agent can spend right now — live x402 market scan with prices and buyer workarounds

hooks.prompt: Audit the paid APIs this plan depends on before implementation starts?
hooks.description: Prompt to grade each paid API the plan calls, so payment failures surface during planning instead of mid-build
